evals.name: personal-site-biotech-ai
evals.prompt: /one-click-site "Personal site for Uri Yablonka, a senior biotech officer and board member who writes about agentic AI in biopharma. Home, about, articles, contact. Keep the existing copy from the current pages." --into site-v2
evals.expected_output: A multi-page static site in <workspace>/builds/<name>/ copied to site-v2/: scroll-craft landing page, About/Articles/Contact built on the same tokens, PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md at the project root, lab/ strips, a report listing assumptions and placeholders, no fabricated credentials or metrics.

evals.name: product-landing-no-assets
evals.prompt: /one-click-site "Landing page for Nightfall, a small-batch cold brew coffee sold in cans. Dark, quiet, premium. No photos yet."
evals.expected_output: A single landing page built on a non-photographic world (typographic, SVG or CSS depth), no grey image boxes, no invented tasting notes or prices unless marked, strips at desktop/mobile/reduced, FINGERPRINTS row appended.

evals.name: studio-with-own-photos
evals.prompt: /one-click-site "Site for Atelier Sul, a two-person architecture studio in Lisbon. Editorial, lots of white space. Our project photos are in ./photos." --assets photos --pages home,work,studio,contact
evals.expected_output: Four pages using the supplied photos as the material, an editorial register with a serif display face chosen on purpose, no generation, Work page listing only projects that have photos, Contact with no invented address or phone.
